result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but horizontally scrolling content is clipped awkwardly at the right edge, and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the restaurant content.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant card are visibly cut off at the screen edge; the restaurant name is also clipped without a clear truncation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent carousel padding and spacing, and use an ellipsis for clipped restaurant names. Show enough of the next item to make horizontal scrolling feel intentional.

issues.description: The second large restaurant card is covered by the fixed bottom navigation, causing its image to end abruptly behind the bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The “−100%” discount badge is unusual and may look like malformed promotional copy.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion value and replace it with clearer wording such as “100% off” if that is the intended offer.
